how_to_change: Change a rule, a region, an alias or an override by a reviewed pull request that edits this file, then regenerate etl/04_integration (python -m src.integration.psa_school_age_population_psgc sql|gate). tests/test_integration_school_age.py fails until the files match.

source.note: One map row per (census_year, place_name, parent_name) at level city_municipality, from both population concepts; none is dropped. Countries, regions and provinces are not mapped: they are sums of their cities and municipalities (D-053). The lineage columns name the place row on the total sheet.

psgc.version_rule: Match only against the master quarter (is_master_reference = TRUE in psa_psgc_clean, today 2026-Q2), for both census years: a 2020 place is mapped to the unit that holds it today. When the master quarter changes, the map is rebuilt and the gate's records show what moved.

order: override: a reviewed entry below, for one census year, applied before every rule
region: the place's region_name is listed below for its census year, with the PSGC regions it covers today; an unlisted region gets no match

parent: a place under a province is searched only inside the PSGC province found for it: a reviewed province alias below, else the one PSGC province (or blank-level container, such as the Special Geographic Area) inside the listed regions whose name or old name matches the province name; a place directly under its region (NCR, Pateros, the highly urbanized cities, City of Isabela) only among that region's cities and municipalities that have no PSGC province
name in parent: the name matches exactly one city or municipality of that parent at the first tier that matches anything; two or more at that tier is ambiguous
unmatched: nothing above applies, or no PSGC parent was found (a name is never searched across provinces)
name_tiers: exact (name_exact): upper case, spaces collapsed, a trailing (Capital) dropped, 'City of X' read as 'X City'
folded (name_normalized): accents and the punctuation . - ' dropped
word City ignored (name_normalized): the words CITY and OF dropped, so a municipality that became a city matches
old name (name_old): the place name against PSGC old_names, or the place's bracketed 2020 old name against the PSGC name or old_names, folded
